title: Irrigation Equipment - Design, Installation and Operation of Sprinkler Irrigation Systems - Code of Practice
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the procedure for the design, installation and operation of sprinkler systems used for irrigation of agricultural lands, orchards, lawns and land scoped areas.
clause_3_terminology: Installation and Operation of Sprinkler Irrigation Systems

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
